title: Arena returns

sound: Arena music resumes loud mid-phrase; the fan cuts dead
control: Move, attack, dodge and block available; connection still unstable

title: Lia lands a hit

duration: Spell travel 0.3 s, flinch 0.2 s, chat stays 1.5 s
control: Player can still act; mid-match chat is read-only

title: You try to block, late
action: Player presses block. The wolf's guard (gray shield slab in front of it) appears 0.4 s after the press, after the second spell has already passed. NETWORK DELAY flashes once in the top band; the wizard keeps moving.
sound: Button press, then a delayed guard clack after the hit
control: Input accepted, resolved late; the world never pauses
note: Same NETWORK DELAY device as Scene 2; v0.3 shows no millisecond number here.

title: Knocked off the platform
action: The wizard's follow-up launches the wolf right and up past the platform edge, rotated 20 degrees, beyond the arena border. DEFEAT drops in over the arena after 0.3 s; the wizard returns to idle on the left.
duration: Launch 0.5 s, result hold until advance
note: v0.3: Your character gets knocked off the platform. DEFEAT.

title: Disconnect: the screen folds inward
overlay:
CONNECTION LOST
RECONNECTING TO HOST: lia_ph
action: The arena image creases down the middle and folds inward toward the center like paper closing, taking the chat with it. No crack and no thrown controller this time. The fold ends in a thin vertical line of light.
camera: Fixed wide; the fold happens inside the frame
sound: Music pitches down and stops; soft suction, far quieter than the first pull
duration: Fold 0.9 s, line of light 0.4 s
